purpose: Identify missing installation guidance in a sample project's README.

authorization.grantedBy: EXAMPLE ONLY - replace with the actual approving owner
authorization.text: EXAMPLE ONLY. This file grants no authority. Replace this record with the owner's actual scoped approval before using a reviewed declaration.

constraints: Read only the approved project evidence. Do not edit files, run project commands, merge, deploy or access production.
Do not read or reproduce credentials, private conversations or customer data. Report unavailable evidence as unavailable.
Provide a report only. The supervisor may publish it only to the owner's actual authorized issue after independent verification.

tasks.title: Review the README installation instructions
tasks.outcome: A new reader can see which installation instructions are missing.
tasks.goal: Inspect the supplied README evidence, identify missing prerequisites or unclear startup instructions, and propose precise corrections. Do not claim to have installed or run the project.
acceptance: Every finding names its supporting README section or line, or explicitly identifies missing evidence.
Recommendations are separated from observed behavior; no claim says the project was executed.
No code change, production action or secret value is included.
